quotes.name: Selfie Preservation
quotes.flavor: "Be sure to get the tree in the picture."

quotes.name: Goblin Chariot
quotes.flavor: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

quotes.name: Godless Shrine
quotes.flavor: The Second Sun brought nothing but darkness.

quotes.name: Nantuko Disciple
quotes.flavor:
Unanswered prayers are themselves answers.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Shattered Sanctum
quotes.flavor: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.

quotes.name: Grimdancer
quotes.flavor: Most monsters are more frightening when they skitter unseen in the dark. Most.

quotes.name: Ardent Recruit
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: "We lost our homes and our kin. We won't let those rotters take our future as well."

quotes.name: Feed the Swarm
quotes.flavor: "All it took was a little Time. And all for this, to get beyond any one universe, to find Division, to get revenge on those who imprisoned us so long ago. To take them all."

quotes.name: Station Monitor
quotes.flavor: "Keeping tabs on a whole station is too much for just one."

quotes.name: Daring Waverider
quotes.flavor: "Look what I found!"

quotes.name: Victory's Herald
quotes.flavor: The corruption stirred the heavens above, awaking a shining champion.

quotes.name: Leonin Skyhunter
quotes.flavor: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

quotes.name: Magus of the Wheel
quotes.flavor: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

quotes.name: Expressive Iteration
quotes.flavor:
"Whaddaya say Flame-Os, let's put on a real show!"
—Human Torch, Johnny Storm

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Malignus
quotes.flavor: It descended on Estwald like a sudden storm. Moments later, only ashes and agony remained.

quotes.name: Bloodhall Ooze
quotes.flavor: A drop of blood spilled from the first dragon.

quotes.name: Lightning Strike
quotes.flavor: Invoking Thor's wrath is a mistake few villains are stupid enough—or sturdy enough—to make twice.

quotes.name: Make Your Own Luck
quotes.flavor:
"Aim alone won't win you a duel if you can't keep your nerve."
—Annie Flash

quotes.name: Angel of Finality
quotes.flavor: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

quotes.name: Ondu Inversion // Ondu Skyruins
quotes.flavor:
"It always seems so quiet in the aftermath of wrenching violence."
—Nys Dal, Sea Gate trapfinder

quotes.name: Old Fogey
quotes.flavor: "These kids today with their collector numbers and their newfangled tap symbol. Twenty Black Lotuses and twenty Plague Rats. Now that's *real* Magic."

quotes.name: Codecracker Hound
quotes.flavor: Even across the Edge, a dog is still a dog.

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"The beauty of it is they never see it coming. Ever."
—Razzix, sparkmage

quotes.name: Robotics Mastery
quotes.flavor: Mendel Stromm didn't just seek revenge. He engineered it.

quotes.name: Fireball
quotes.flavor: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

quotes.name: Squall
quotes.flavor:
"May the winds blow till they have wakened death. . . ."
—William Shakespeare,
*Othello*

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Bay Falcon
quotes.flavor:
"Wear the falcon's feathers in your hair—
be fast as the falcon, bright as the Sun."
—"Rise on Wings," Zhalfirin song

quotes.name: Spitting Dilophosaurus
quotes.flavor: "Nice boy . . . nice boy. Nice dinosaur!"

quotes.name: Kemba, Kha Regent
quotes.flavor: "I am not Raksha. I never will be. But I refuse to be the kha who watched her pride be torn asunder."

quotes.name: Passageway Seer
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "I'm certain there's a shortcut here . . ."

quotes.name: Animal Attendant
quotes.flavor: Despite a lack of funds, the elderly zookeeper tried his very best to care for his animals.

quotes.name: Coastal Piracy
quotes.flavor: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

quotes.name: Ardent Militia
quotes.flavor: Some fight for honor and some for gold, but the militia fight for hearth and home.

quotes.name: Righteousness
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.

quotes.name: Burrenton Forge-Tender
quotes.flavor: "We are a clachan of smiths. The forge is as comfortable to us as a small fire during a cool winter's evening."

quotes.name: Profane Procession // Tomb of the Dusk Rose
quotes.flavor: . . . resting in the splendor of the dead.

quotes.name: Stupor
quotes.flavor:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Banisher Priest
quotes.flavor: "Oathbreaker, I cast you out!"

quotes.name: Mage Hunters' Onslaught
quotes.flavor: Extus stood before his alma mater for a moment, remembering first his studies, then his vengeance. At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.

quotes.name: Shore Snapper
quotes.flavor: Kathari, the sickly aven of Grixis, have learned that the corpses by the shoreline are more trap than treat.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

quotes.name: Koma's Faithful
quotes.flavor: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."

quotes.name: Skull Saucer
quotes.flavor: No body is ready for this kind of power.

quotes.name: Brood Monitor
quotes.flavor: The tenderness of a mother. The pity of a mantis.

quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, so you're my replacements. Huh. A dandy and a clown. Have you done anything?"
—The First Doctor

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Sword of the Animist
quotes.flavor: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

quotes.name: Slith Firewalker
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

quotes.name: Give In to Violence
quotes.flavor:
"Come. Strip yourself of flesh and fear. Hunt for me. *Entertain* me."
—The Lord of Pain

quotes.name: Aether Tradewinds
quotes.flavor:
"The wind smells of misfortune. Check your knots."
—Anitan, Ondu cleric

quotes.name: Arm the Cathars
quotes.flavor: Faith is a cathar's greatest weapon, but a sword of blessed silver is a close second.

quotes.name: Misthios's Fury
quotes.flavor:
"I'm tired of all this sneaking. Come out and face me!"
—Kassandra, Eagle Bearer

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Haunting Hymn
quotes.flavor: The hymn's melody has persisted since Tourach's time, but the words changed to invoke the phobias of each listener.

quotes.name: Ogre Slumlord
quotes.flavor:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

quotes.name: Geist-Fueled Scarecrow
quotes.flavor:
"It'll keep the crows away. Works on neighbors too."
—Old Rutstein

quotes.name: Gravity Well
quotes.flavor: Storms spread throughout Oran-Rief, ripping the skies with wind and rain. Airborne creatures sought shelter where they could.

quotes.name: Mirror Entity
quotes.flavor: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

quotes.name: Ertai, Wizard Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Was that *it*?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Ravenous Squirrel
quotes.flavor:
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels."
—Joskun, An-Havva constable

quotes.name: Buy Your Silence
quotes.flavor: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

quotes.name: Bant Panorama
quotes.flavor: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

quotes.name: Order of the Golden Cricket
quotes.flavor:
"Should you take it in mind to ride a springjack, remember: there are easier ways to fly, and harder ways to break your skull."
—Lann of Cloverdell

quotes.name: Captain Vargus Wrath
quotes.flavor: "To be a successful cutthroat, you have to truly enjoy the work."

quotes.name: Sparksmith
quotes.flavor: "If it didn't hurt, how would I know it worked?"

quotes.name: Curio Vendor
quotes.flavor: "Step right up! Try your hand! It'll thrill the senses and boggle the mind!"

quotes.name: Doors of Durin
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Speak, friend, and enter."

quotes.name: Paradise Mantle
quotes.flavor:
"It contains the wisdom of generations of our people. We permit only a chosen few to don the raiment."
—Imran, Viridian elder

quotes.name: Harbin, Vanguard Aviator
quotes.flavor: "Yotia is my birthright, father. Let me fight for it."

quotes.name: Plagued Rusalka
quotes.flavor:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

quotes.name: Indulging Patrician
quotes.flavor: "Just a nibble for now. I wouldn't want to ruin my appetite."

quotes.name: Snake Basket
quotes.flavor:
"Uh, does anyone have a flute?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

quotes.name: Deadeye Rig-Hauler
quotes.flavor: "Up you go, you soggy rat."

quotes.name: Ritual of Hope
quotes.flavor: "Tonight, we can be anything."

quotes.name: Wall of Junk
quotes.flavor: Urza saw the wall and realized that even if he tore every Phyrexian to pieces, they would still resist him.

quotes.name: Twisted Image
quotes.flavor:
"True strength is in the mind, for the body is too malleable a form."
—Politus, vedalken emisar

quotes.name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
quotes.flavor: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

quotes.name: Independent Troops
quotes.flavor: "The empire, long united, must divide, and long divided, must unite."

quotes.name: Judge's Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor."
—Barvisa, courtroom scribe

quotes.name: Ground Assault
quotes.flavor:
"Taking down a dragon is easy. All you need is enough space to get in a good swing."
—Narbulg Nine Fingers

quotes.name: Dromoka, the Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"The bane of countless shattered weapons, each a failure to slay her."
—Daghatar the Adamant

quotes.name: Noctis, Prince of Lucis
quotes.flavor: Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.

quotes.name: Aetherize
quotes.flavor: No berzerker charge can stand against the psychic might of the Hive Mind.

quotes.name: Loam Dweller
quotes.flavor:
"You know its mood by the plants that spring up around it. When it is placid, fields of lilies flow in its wake; when it is angry, every stem has a thorn."
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

quotes.name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
quotes.flavor: Devourer of the Obzedat, tithe-drinker, and necroparun eternal.

quotes.name: Fertile Ground
quotes.flavor: The forest was too lush for the brothers to despoil—almost.

quotes.name: Regal Force
quotes.flavor: It rarely moves, standing stock still in its clearing. When it does stir, ravens stop their cawing and crickets their chirping. All of nature watches in awed silence.

quotes.name: Draconic Visitor
quotes.flavor:
"What is that?! A firebreathing sphinx?"
—Derenk, Hexhaven cadet

quotes.name: Sanguine Bond
quotes.flavor:
"The witch smiled, savoring every stolen year. Every love the knight would never court, every meal he'd never taste, every honor he'd never win, was sweet as honey on her tongue."
—*Hexes of Dunbarrow*

quotes.name: Roaring Primadox
quotes.flavor:
"They're easy enough to find. Question is, are you sure you want to find one?"
—Juruk, Kalonian tracker

quotes.name: Mortal Flesh Is Weak
quotes.flavor: "I certainly would have accepted my offer of eternal life. But if you choose death instead, who am I to argue?"

quotes.name: Hawkeye, Bowslinger
quotes.flavor: "Go out, fight hard, screw up. Save the world a few times . . . Just keep taking the shots, okay?"

quotes.name: Djeru's Resolve
quotes.flavor: "When I wish to be strong, I train. When I wish to be wise, I study. When I wish to rest, I start again."

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: In the late stages of a Tyranid invasion, vast capillary towers funnel biomass to the Hive Ships waiting in orbit.

quotes.name: Curse of Disturbance
quotes.flavor: Sounds of life beckon many a restless soul.

quotes.name: Skitter Eel
quotes.flavor:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Wheel of Sun and Moon
quotes.flavor: Every life ends, but life itself never does.

quotes.name: Goblin War Drums
quotes.flavor: The War Drums enabled Goblin and Orcish armies to crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: James, Wandering Dad // Follow Him
quotes.flavor: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

quotes.name: Thriving Moor
quotes.flavor: Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.

quotes.name: Razorverge Thicket
quotes.flavor: Where evolution meets austerity, primal might bucks against the yoke of hierarchy.

quotes.name: Telepathy
quotes.flavor:
"The most disappointing thing about learning telepathy is finding out how boring people really are."
—Teferi, fourth-level student

quotes.name: Aggressive Urge
quotes.flavor: "Our lives, our homes, and all our history are at risk. Do not speak to me of peace."

quotes.name: Kher Keep
quotes.flavor:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

quotes.name: Danny Pink
quotes.flavor: "I don't want to see more things. I want to see the things in front of me more clearly."

quotes.name: Whispersilk Cloak
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"It bends the light somehow, rendering it—and its wearer—functionally invisible. I never would have found it if I hadn't tripped over it!"
—Quintorius Kand, research notes

quotes.name: Overlaid Terrain
quotes.flavor: One must reap before one can sow.

quotes.name: Nettle Swine
quotes.flavor:
"I killed one and found bricks and bones in its belly. It had eaten a whole cottage, thatch and all."
—Paulin, Somberwald trapper

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Burrenton Shield-Bearers
quotes.flavor: Soul and bones, kithkin are woven into their clans. They fight fiercely and without self-interest.

quotes.name: Mockingbird
quotes.flavor: "Laughing at you? No, no, I'm laughing *as* you!"

quotes.name: Alluring Siren
quotes.flavor:
"The ground polluted floats with human gore,
And human carnage taints the dreadful shore
Fly swift the dangerous coast: let every ear
Be stopp'd against the song! 'tis death to hear!"
—Homer, *The Odyssey*, trans. Pope

quotes.name: Dune Drifter
quotes.flavor: It was easy for them to replace lost crew members once they reached home turf.

quotes.name: Temporal Trespass
quotes.flavor:
"I do not wish to speak with you, but through you. You are the prophet. You've played your part."
—Minerva

quotes.name: Boon-Bringer Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: Her blades were twin beacons, calling the worthy to glory and the wretched to despair.

quotes.name: Ray of Revelation
quotes.flavor: Webs of illusion unravel in the light of truth.

quotes.name: Dispel
quotes.flavor:
"I said we should destroy the Eldrazi. Ugin wanted to return them to stasis. Ugin's arguments were . . . unconvincing."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Vizzerdrix
quotes.flavor: Its swamp cousin may be meaner, but the vizzerdrix is much bigger.

quotes.name: Filigree Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"It's the must-have gift for everyone on your list. Get one for yourself, too!"
—Chammi, curio vendor

quotes.name: Nesting Grounds
quotes.flavor: A butterfly will lead the way to secret things.

quotes.name: Spinny Ride
quotes.flavor: There's no such thing as upside down in space. Put another way, there are infinite upside downs in space.

quotes.name: Temporal Manipulation
quotes.flavor: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: "Once we have claimed this planet, we will claim the stars."

quotes.name: Twinblade Geist // Twinblade Invocation
quotes.flavor: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.

quotes.name: Canyon Slough
quotes.flavor: Gamma radiation destroys all it touches, save for an unlucky few.

quotes.name: Boomerang Basics
quotes.flavor: "All right buddy, don't fail me now!"

quotes.name: Alabaster Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We hold sacred the powers of light and life. Truth and honor are our greatest weapons."
—Alabaster creed

quotes.name: Pest Infestation
quotes.flavor: Pest Problem Plagues Eatery—"Never Thought I'd Miss the Rats," Owner Laments

quotes.name: Filigree Attendant
quotes.flavor:
"The perfect assistant is one that's responsive, dexterous, and capable of reaching all the high shelves."
—Coruk, Esper artificer

quotes.name: Sift
quotes.flavor: Dwell longest on the thoughts that shine brightest.

quotes.name: Atog
quotes.flavor: The bane of all artificers, the legendary Atogs devoured intricate tools to further their own twisted growth.

quotes.name: Felidar Guardian
quotes.flavor: The loyalty of a felidar is hard won but worth the effort.

quotes.name: Pack Leader
quotes.flavor: He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.

quotes.name: Castle Embereth
quotes.flavor: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

quotes.name: Dragon's Presence
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor:
"The Ancestor Dragon appeared atop the clouds, amid shattering mountains and sundering earth."
—Jiang Yanggu's travelogue

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Forge Devil
quotes.flavor: A bit of pain never hurts.

quotes.name: Kaust, Eyes of the Glade
quotes.flavor: If you think you're being watched, you're probably right.

quotes.name: Rabid Gnaw
quotes.flavor: Unbeknownst to the hosts, the foraged seeds they served at dinner had been touched by a Calamity Beast. The results were ... disturbing.

quotes.name: Harrowing Journey
quotes.flavor:
"There are always fools who attempt to traverse Kruin Pass before sundown and every time they wind up in a race for their lives."
—Old Rutstein

quotes.name: Scroll of Fate
quotes.flavor:
"Our stories define our reality."
—Ugin

quotes.name: Monstrify
quotes.flavor: Gackt came to regret keeping his pet toads on his head.

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

quotes.name: Growth Spurt
quotes.flavor: MORE TO LOVE: Friendly, nature-loving, Bunyonesque SEM seeks SEF looking for a huge commitment. . . . seeks atog prince

quotes.name: Crested Herdcaller
quotes.flavor:
"Our survival, like theirs, depends on our ability to work together."
—Huatli, to Tishana

quotes.name: Fanatical Offering
quotes.flavor: The gateway could be opened only by the spilling of innocent blood. Vito did not hesitate.

quotes.name: Valor in Akros
quotes.flavor: There's no stronger armor than the bravery of those beside you.

quotes.name: Visions of Villainy
quotes.flavor: As Thanos gazed into the cosmic vortex of the Infinity Well, he beheld the means to serve Death all the better.

quotes.name: Ezuri's Predation
quotes.flavor: "Those who do not submit will be consumed."

quotes.name: Echoing Return
quotes.flavor: A single ambition unleashes a legion of horrors.

quotes.name: Floodfarm Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

quotes.name: Regal Bunnicorn
quotes.flavor:
"It's entirely peaceful, as long as you don't try to pet it, pen it, take its food, take its hide, sit on its grass, or dress it up in colorful garb for human holidays."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

quotes.name: Holy Day
quotes.flavor:
"The day of Spirits; my soul's calm retreat / Which none disturb!"
—Henry Vaughan, "The Night"

quotes.name: Foil
quotes.flavor: Among wizards, poor timing is the most consistent mistake.

quotes.name: Jokulhaups
quotes.flavor:
"I was shocked when I first saw the aftermath of the Yavimaya Valley disaster. The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

quotes.name: Epic Confrontation
quotes.flavor: No matter the timeline, some legends will endure.

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

quotes.name: Wanderbrine Rootcutters
quotes.flavor: Most dirtwalkers only know of the vicious merrows that dwell in the shallows. They can't begin to fathom the wickedness that skulks in the Dark Meanders.

quotes.name: The Gaffer
quotes.flavor: On the growing of vegetables, especially potatoes, Master Hamfast Gamgee was recognized as the leading authority by all in the neighborhood.

quotes.name: Ambassador Oak
quotes.flavor: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

quotes.name: Graceful Takedown
quotes.flavor: The fauns of the Tanglespan are adept at using the precarious environment against larger opponents.

quotes.name: Giant Opportunity
quotes.flavor: They look tasty, but best to plant them.

quotes.name: Blue Sun's Zenith
quotes.flavor:
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it."
—Pelyus, vedalken ordinar

quotes.name: Aggressive Biomancy
quotes.flavor:
"I am an esteemed scientist. Base violence is beneath me. Luckily, it's not beneath my subjects."
—Gulistan, Simic biomancer

quotes.name: Storm Crow
quotes.flavor: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

quotes.name: Galadriel's Dismissal
quotes.flavor: "The love of the Elves for their land and their works is deeper than the deeps of the Sea. Yet they will cast all away rather than submit to Sauron—for they *know* him now."

quotes.name: Jace Beleren // Jace Beleren
quotes.flavor: Pitcher

quotes.name: Brotherhood Vertibird
quotes.flavor: As tough as the armored troops it carries.

quotes.name: Bruna, the Fading Light // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

quotes.name: Master of the Feast
quotes.flavor: Any pleasure, when taken to excess, becomes torment. It's a formula that demons have perfected.

quotes.name: Temporal Extortion
quotes.flavor: "Let us start a new reign of terror. I will let you live a fantasy beyond your imagination."

quotes.name: Xu-Ifit, Osteoharmonist
quotes.flavor: "They will call you a monster, but I call you worthy."

quotes.name: Hecteyes
quotes.flavor:
"Once, the monsters of Hell poured forth into the world. They entered using a path known as the Jade Passage."
—Hilda, Princess of Fynn

quotes.name: Moonlight Bargain
quotes.flavor: At every fifth full moon, the Moon Market convenes to peddle Ravnica's most forbidden wares.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

quotes.name: Manifestation Sage
quotes.flavor: The first thing a Quandrix mage learns is the laws of metaphysics. The second thing is how to break them.

quotes.name: Rockfall Vale
quotes.flavor: Cries of panic echo along Kessig's narrow ravines as howlpacks herd their prey.

quotes.name: Man-o'-War
quotes.flavor:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

quotes.name: Skirge Familiar
quotes.flavor: The first Yawgmoth priest to harness their power was rewarded with several unique mutilations.

quotes.name: Infernal Reckoning
quotes.flavor: "When these intruders are gone, Zendikar will be my throne, my palace, my playground."

quotes.name: Feed the Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

quotes.name: Bastion Protector
quotes.flavor: "By this oath, I pledge to stand by thee, against traitor, beast, or fiend, for only in death does duty end."

quotes.name: Sheoldred's Headcleaver
quotes.flavor: The punishment for sedition, like every other crime in the Dross Pits, is execution.

quotes.name: Pyroclasm
quotes.flavor:
"Leaves more room for the big ones to fight in, you know."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Acorn Catapult
quotes.flavor: The Kalonian word for "ammunition" is the same as the word for "bait."

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor: In places where the sea meets the trees, it's easy to forget the darkness that rules most of Innistrad.

quotes.name: Auriok Champion
quotes.flavor:
"Her will shall banish the shadows. Her might shall punish the lawless. Her beauty shall restore the light."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

quotes.name: Scavenging Harpy
quotes.flavor: Desecrating the dead is a convenient way for harpies to expand their foul collections.

quotes.name: Thaumatic Compass // Spires of Orazca
quotes.flavor:
". . . a cryptic objective."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

quotes.name: Flame-Kin War Scout
quotes.flavor:
"The forward flame-kin are popping. We have incoming!"
—Svar, Boros signaler

quotes.name: Witherbloom Campus
quotes.flavor: Mage-students fascinated by the energies of life and death choose Witherbloom, the college of essence studies.

quotes.name: Veinwitch Coven
quotes.flavor: Some Strixhaven study groups are more welcoming than others.

quotes.name: Mystic Monastery
quotes.flavor: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

quotes.name: Sylvan Scrying
quotes.flavor: One glimpse of an elf's home lasts her weeks away in the wild.

quotes.name: Inkwell Leviathan
quotes.flavor:
"Into its maw went the seventh sea, never to be seen again while the world remains."
—Esper fable

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

quotes.name: Ochran Assassin
quotes.flavor: "The dagger is just the distraction. I carry the real killer in a vial at my side."

quotes.name: Toxic Deluge
quotes.flavor:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

quotes.name: Tenacious Tosk
quotes.flavor: "I am Tosk, the hunted. I live to outwit the Hunters for another day. To survive until I die with honor. But that will not be my fate."

quotes.name: Foam Weapons Kiosk
quotes.flavor: Nothing is safe in the hands of an eight-year-old.

quotes.name: Archelos, Lagoon Mystic
quotes.flavor: "Life ... is not ... a race."

quotes.name: Sudden Strike
quotes.flavor: Sometimes, one decisive blow is all it takes to turn a fight around.

quotes.name: Burst Lightning
quotes.flavor:
「最後の敵が斃れしとき、嵐が跪かんことを。」
――「オタリア人の喊声」

quotes.name: Rona, Sheoldred's Faithful
quotes.flavor: "Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of *compleation*."

quotes.name: Thunderclap Wyvern
quotes.flavor: Thunder doesn't always mean rain. Sometimes it means ruin.

quotes.name: Beasts of Bogardan
quotes.flavor: Bogardan is a land as volatile as the creatures who live there.

quotes.name: Grim Tutor
quotes.flavor: As blood touched the empty page, it formed words that seared themselves into the wizard's mind.

quotes.name: Fate Unraveler
quotes.flavor:
"Never forget that the life you've built can be undone by a single loose thread."
—Perisophia the philosopher

quotes.name: Fusion Elemental
quotes.flavor: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

quotes.name: Intangible Virtue
quotes.flavor: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

quotes.name: Vandalblast
quotes.flavor: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

quotes.name: Life from the Loam
quotes.flavor:
"On a good day, I am not Fangkeeper, war hero, or sibsig, but a farmer again."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

quotes.name: Paladin Elizabeth Taggerdy
quotes.flavor: "Into the killing ground!"

quotes.name: Corpse Augur
quotes.flavor: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

quotes.name: Stoneskin
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Ooh, nice shot! I almost felt that one."

quotes.name: Thirst for Knowledge
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."

quotes.name: Ravenous Rats
quotes.flavor: Nothing is sacred to the rats. Everything is simply another meal.

quotes.name: Archaeomancer
quotes.flavor: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

quotes.name: Capital Guard
quotes.flavor: Fire Nation guards rely more on fear than fire.

quotes.name: Ranger en-Vec
quotes.flavor:
"The path of least resistance will seldom lead you beyond your doorstep."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Defensive Formation
quotes.flavor:
"Your enemies will pound upon the door of your defenses, but only you shall have the key, and it is the key of life."
—*Song of All*, canto 873

quotes.name: Stupefying Touch
quotes.flavor: Just because your eyes are open doesn't mean you're awake.

quotes.name: Dockworker Drone
quotes.flavor: Eternity columns are the trade hubs of every solar system.

quotes.name: Zombie Infestation
quotes.flavor: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

quotes.name: Read the Bones
quotes.flavor: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
"They are convenient in having no souls, but less so in having no spirit."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Fraying Sanity
quotes.flavor: Those wound tightest are first to unravel.

quotes.name: Exhibition Tidecaller
quotes.flavor:
"Dangerously overflowing with creative expression."
—*Strixhaven Star* gallery show review

quotes.name: Diabolic Edict
quotes.flavor: Greven il-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.

quotes.name: Creeping Mold
quotes.flavor: The deadliest force on Mirrodin isn't the largest organism—it's the smallest.

quotes.name: Prismatic Lens
quotes.flavor: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

quotes.name: Shadow of Mortality
quotes.flavor:
"Build your towers as tall as you want. The shadow always reaches higher."
—Message scrawled on an alley wall

quotes.name: Might of the Meek
quotes.flavor:
"Fear is unavoidable. You can run from it with your tail between your legs, or charge it head on with sword in hand. I prefer the latter."
—Rho, veteran hero

quotes.name: Smuggler's Share
quotes.flavor: One way or another, everyone gets paid what they're owed.

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: Charging alone takes uncommong daring or uncommon stupidity. Or both.

quotes.name: Cha'DIch Investigator
quotes.flavor: Klingons who challenge the High Council are denied the right of personal combat. They must select a second—a *cha'DIch*—to defend them.

quotes.name: Bog Rats
quotes.flavor: Their stench was vile and strong enough, but not nearly as powerful as their hunger.

quotes.name: Deep Analysis
quotes.flavor: "The specimen seems to be broken."

quotes.name: Severed Strands
quotes.flavor: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

quotes.name: Warmonger Hellkite
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Its wings beat to the howls of war and fan the fires of rage.

quotes.name: Cascade Bluffs
quotes.flavor: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

quotes.name: Powerstone Minefield
quotes.flavor:
"We have fought this far and lost too much. We will not turn back."
—Grizzlegom

quotes.name: Norin the Wary
quotes.flavor: "I have a bad feeling about this."

quotes.name: Lightning Elemental
quotes.flavor: A lightning elemental once killed an entire tribe of merfolk—simply by going for a swim.

quotes.name: Hibernation Sliver
quotes.flavor: Mogglings have been known to play ball with hibernating slivers, completely unaware of their true nature.

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor: Knowing the Hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.

quotes.name: Raise the Past
quotes.flavor: At Strixhaven University, learning about the past means talking to those who were there.

quotes.name: Oketra's Monument
quotes.flavor:
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Psychic Drain
quotes.flavor:
"Gold can be reearned, goods restored. The moroii steal youth, more precious than either, and once gone, it's gone forever."
—Berta Suszat, civic healer

quotes.name: Loot, the Key to Everything
quotes.flavor: The vault's ultimate prize wasn't exactly what Kellan had imagined.

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

quotes.name: Sedge Troll
quotes.flavor: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

quotes.name: Big Play
quotes.flavor:
"Quandrix is running out of time. If they're going to capture the Witherbloom mascot, they need something big here."
—Cremik, Mage Tower commentator

quotes.name: Vengeance
quotes.flavor: Bitter as wormwood, sweet as mulled wine.

quotes.name: Anurid Brushhopper
quotes.flavor: It's so tough it can frighten itself into hiding.

quotes.name: Hieromancer's Cage
quotes.flavor: Law protects but also contains.

quotes.name: Dust Corona
quotes.flavor:
"They infiltrated deep into the enemy camp under cover of darkness . . . and dirt."
—Corus, viashino warrior

quotes.name: Sizzle
quotes.flavor:
"Of course you should fight fire with fire. You should fight *everything* with fire."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Ceaseless Conflict
quotes.flavor:
"War begets war. We may hope for peace, but it is only ever a brief interlude between bloody ages."
—Plargg, dean of chaos

quotes.name: Incite Rebellion
quotes.flavor: Nothing breaks the monotony like a good old-fashioned riot.

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Angel of the God-Pharaoh
quotes.flavor: The angels did not deceive. From the start, they were clear their allegiance was to the God-Pharaoh and to him alone.

quotes.name: Horde of Notions
quotes.flavor: Even the oldest treefolk was but an acorn when Lorwyn's first mysteries were born.

quotes.name: Eyes of the Wisent
quotes.flavor:
Calm as a wisent's watch
—Elvish expression meaning "safe"

quotes.name: Mirrormade
quotes.flavor:
"Share your darkest secret and the Mirror will reveal your soul's essence."
—Ceri, royal mirrorkeeper

quotes.name: Kellan's Lightblades
quotes.flavor: Kellan struck out on pure instinct, and his conjured blades cleaved through the icy guardians as though they were nothing but air.

quotes.name: It That Gets Left Hanging
quotes.flavor: "Give me . . . some skin."

quotes.name: Hinterland Logger // Timber Shredder
quotes.flavor:
"She even had the audacity to criticize my wares as inferior."
—Old Rutstein

quotes.name: Boros Charm
quotes.flavor:
"Practice compassion and mercy. But know when they must end."
—Aurelia

quotes.name: Orzhov Advokist
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

quotes.name: Impostor Syndrome
quotes.flavor:
"I'm the real Spider-Man!"
"No, *I'm* the real Spider-Man!"

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: It is said that aetheryte is the solid manifestation of the planet's lifeblood, aether, and that by touching it, the aether which makes up our bodies resonates with that contained in the crystal.

quotes.name: Encroach
quotes.flavor:
"The rate of spread in this region is unacceptable. Start again."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

quotes.name: Junk Diver
quotes.flavor: Garbage in, treasure out.

quotes.name: Lecturing Scornmage
quotes.flavor: "I expected better from you."

quotes.name: Glacial Fortress
quotes.flavor: Ships blown north in their voyage across the Stormwreck Sea become trapped in the unmelting ice.

quotes.name: Thalia, Heretic Cathar
quotes.flavor: "Salvation will not be granted by the Lunarch Council. It must be earned—at the edge of a sword, if necessary."

quotes.name: Treasure Map // Treasure Cove
quotes.flavor: Half the treasure is the glory of finding it.

quotes.name: Clear the Stage
quotes.flavor: "Make way! It's time for the final act!"

quotes.name: Hero's Blade
quotes.flavor: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

quotes.name: Steam Frigate
quotes.flavor:
"Is it merchants or is it pirates?"
"It's Talas—there's no difference."

quotes.name: Kelsien, the Plague
quotes.flavor: "There is no greater glory than fighting to find the truth."

quotes.name: Flamekin Brawler
quotes.flavor: Cuando quema gente, se quedan quemados.

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Sure-Footed Infiltrator
quotes.flavor: "I've yet to discover the ruin that can keep me out."

quotes.name: Farmer Cotton
quotes.flavor: "So it's begun at last! I've been itching for trouble all this year."

quotes.name: Skinrender
quotes.flavor:
"Your creations are effective, Sheoldred, but we must unite the flesh, not merely flay it."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Earth Elemental
quotes.flavor: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

quotes.name: Bog Initiate
quotes.flavor:
"Urborg's magic is strong. Did Urza send you to protect us or to protect against us?"
—Urborg witch, to Barrin

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Gargoyle
quotes.flavor: The gargoyles were taken from the walls of flooded Kjeldoran cities and brought upland to guard the outposts of New Argive.

quotes.name: Arashin Sunshield
quotes.flavor:
"The best way to protect the citizens is to defend Arashin, not hunt dragonstorms across Tarkir."
—Sadesh of House Mevak

quotes.name: Timber Gorge
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor: Near the Western Seas lies Mount Zhaoyao—a forest of stones that reaches the clouds, a bountiful land of wondrous treasures and strange animals.

quotes.name: Scuttling Butler
quotes.flavor: Porter, cleaner, and bouncer all in one.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"Twenty-seven planets in perfect balance. Come on, that is gorgeous!"
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Horned Troll
quotes.flavor:
"If I says it's a troll, it's a troll. Goblins is always right in Mercadia."
—Squee

quotes.name: Raging Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The only thing worse than a minotaur with an axe is an angry minotaur with an axe.

quotes.name: Artful Dodge
quotes.flavor: Those who know the alleys and sewers of the Erdwal can disappear like smoke.

quotes.name: Maelstrom Colossus
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing of the Maelstrom is quiet or easy."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Celestial Messenger
quotes.flavor:
"It soars on the winds of dreams."
—Mu Yanling

quotes.name: Emancipation Angel
quotes.flavor: "You have done your best. I give you leave to rest."

quotes.name: Radiant Summit
quotes.flavor:
"The Tapestry weaves worlds on its own. All we do is tend to the process."
—Antioxa, Drix elder

quotes.name: Gutless Ghoul
quotes.flavor:
"Make sure those wretches feed only upon the plagued. The blood of the healthy is reserved for me alone."
—Garza Zol, plague queen

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to its problems.

quotes.name: Storm-Kiln Artist
quotes.flavor: A captured elemental makes for a potent, albeit unstable, power source.

quotes.name: Pinkie Pie
quotes.flavor: "Hey, you know what this calls for? A party!"

quotes.name: Soldevi Steam Beast
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing has ever broken my heart so much as this—the betrayal of Soldev by my beloved machines!"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Peek
quotes.flavor: Sometimes you have to read between the minds.

quotes.name: Ronom Unicorn
quotes.flavor: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

quotes.name: J. Jonah Jameson
quotes.flavor: "The photos are garbage, Parker! I'll buy them all."

quotes.name: Sheltered Thicket
quotes.flavor:
"This is a great spot . . . . Traders run close enough for easy pickins, but not so close that we end up skinned."
—Sully's Log

quotes.name: Enigma Drake
quotes.flavor: Many initiates believe it possesses secrets beyond imagining. Many have become meals trying to learn them.

quotes.name: Arrester's Zeal
quotes.flavor: "Law is the light of civilization."

quotes.name: Distant Melody
quotes.flavor: Hark! The Serra Angel sings . . .

quotes.name: Plunge into Winter
quotes.flavor: When Hylda froze Loch Larent to create her palace, some merfolk dove deep enough underwater to escape the chill. Others weren't so lucky.

quotes.name: Ancient Ooze
quotes.flavor: The ooze has always been. The ooze will always be.

quotes.name: Grim Affliction
quotes.flavor: Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.

quotes.name: Dreadful as the Storm
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night! All shall love me and despair!"

quotes.name: Binding Grasp
quotes.flavor:
"What I want, I take."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor:
"The eerie, wailing Hymn caused insanity even in hardened warriors."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

quotes.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
quotes.flavor:
"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: March of the World Ooze
quotes.flavor:
"The fauna here functions as a planar antibody."
—Rashmi, aether-seer

quotes.name: Kiln Fiend
quotes.flavor: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

quotes.name: Journeyer's Kite
quotes.flavor:
"From the clouds, you can see as far as the distant horizon. It's a reminder of the infinite possibilities of everyday life."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Sanctum Prelate
quotes.flavor: "This area is off-limits to you."

quotes.name: Lunarch Mantle
quotes.flavor:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

quotes.name: Devious Cover-Up
quotes.flavor: First, dispose of the evidence. Then dispose of your knowledge of its disposal.

quotes.name: Sustainer of the Realm
quotes.flavor: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

quotes.name: Persistent Specimen
quotes.flavor:
"The jaw bone's connected to the skull bone. The skull bone's connected to the . . . uh . . . hook thingy."
—Garl, sticher's assistant

quotes.name: Worship
quotes.flavor:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

quotes.name: Meneldor, Swift Savior
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Then come! We have need of speed greater than any wind, outmatching the wings of the Nazgûl."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Glen Elendra's Answer
quotes.flavor:
"This is *my* domain, and *I* am its Queen."
—Maralen, fae ascendant

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor:
"You are a time-space machine. You're a vehicle! I've never asked you to cheer me up with hologrammatic antlers!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Blind Obedience
quotes.flavor:
"Man is a beast and it is good that fear fills him."
—Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: The Brotherhood of Steel turned the airport into a mighty stronghold that staged both the *Prydwen* and Liberty Prime.

quotes.name: Foreboding Statue // Forsaken Thresher
quotes.flavor: Were it not for the cultists' fatal curiosity, the terrible machine might have lain dormant for decades more.

quotes.name: Horseshoe Crab
quotes.flavor: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

quotes.name: Wyluli Wolf
quotes.flavor:
"When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?"
—Maimun al-Wyluli, diary

quotes.name: Sickbay Orderly
quotes.flavor:
"I never thought size or strength was particularly important in a medical officer, but I can now say with certainty that they have their uses."
—Dr. Beverly Crusher

quotes.name: Gutter Skulker // Gutter Shortcut
quotes.flavor: Some people take that as inspiration.

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor:
"The 'pinnacle' of advancement is a concept that exists only in the narrow minds of those with no ambition."
—Yawgmoth

quotes.name: Sea Gate Oracle
quotes.flavor: "The secret entrance should be near."

quotes.name: Pact of the Serpent
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "Our quarrels behind us. Our foes before us. Death or triumph for us all!"

quotes.name: Savage Lands
quotes.flavor: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

quotes.name: Dawnstrike Vanguard
quotes.flavor: "Arrive as the dawn, and banish night through your brilliance!"

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: A drop of humanity for a sea of power.

quotes.name: Elven Ambush
quotes.flavor:
"No elf can match a Tuskeri in combat. Why not charge?"
—Knorjolvin, Tuskeri raider

quotes.name: Pitchburn Devils
quotes.flavor: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Reconstruct History
quotes.flavor: ANIMUS INITIALIZING . . . LOADING MEMORY SEQUENCE.

quotes.name: Nausea
quotes.flavor: No fear. No sense. And soon, no lunch.

quotes.name: Sheltered Aerie
quotes.flavor: Dromoka's scalelords patrol the skies over Arashin, offering her people safety from the harsh world.

quotes.name: General's Enforcer
quotes.flavor:
"A veteran ranger inspires awe. Stick around for when they get here, you'll see."
—NCR trooper

quotes.name: Tip the Scales
quotes.flavor:
"Remember, wait till they're near the top. We don't just want them gone—we want them demoralized."
—Vennra, earthcarver tactician

quotes.name: Scavenger Grounds
quotes.flavor: The remnants of titanic clashes, immortalized by the desert sands.

quotes.name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
quotes.flavor: If she commands it, her subjects will burn the world to ash.

quotes.name: Leave in the Dust
quotes.flavor: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

quotes.name: Explosive Vegetation
quotes.flavor: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

quotes.name: Master Decoy
quotes.flavor: A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again.

quotes.name: Snapping Voidcraw
quotes.flavor: Once considered a delicacy, turtle soup is no longer served in Nephalia's inns.

quotes.name: Weird Harvest
quotes.flavor: Krosa's distorted groves bear strange fruit.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Lightning Strike
quotes.flavor: To wield lightning is to tame chaos.

quotes.name: Pavel Maliki
quotes.flavor: We all know the legend: Pavel wanders the realms, helping those in greatest need. But is this a measure of his generosity, or of his obligation to atone?

quotes.name: Molting Snakeskin
quotes.flavor: Flesh wounds are meaningless to those who discard their flesh so readily.

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Stonecoil Serpent
quotes.flavor: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

quotes.name: Baird, Steward of Argive
quotes.flavor: "The walls of Argive were built by a peaceful dynastic union that has guarded us against war for fifteen centuries. The lesson is clear."

quotes.name: Expedition Map
quotes.flavor:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Southern Elephant
quotes.flavor: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Krenko's Command
quotes.flavor: Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

quotes.name: Faerie Invaders
quotes.flavor: Small enough to penetrate the narrowest crack in a castle wall and numerous enough to hack apart a griffin.

quotes.name: Light Up the Stage
quotes.flavor:
"Places, everyone!"
—Judith

quotes.name: Makeshift Mannequin
quotes.flavor:
"This vulgar mimicry will end now."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

quotes.name: Murderous Compulsion
quotes.flavor: "Thank you. This blade becomes so hot in my hand, but your blood has quenched it."

quotes.name: Tundra
quotes.flavor: 2015 Legacy Championship Winner

quotes.name: Wirewood Symbiote
quotes.flavor:
"Let the wild in. Channel its strength."
—Freyalise

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: The pride of Calverton was now the town's only marker.

quotes.name: Jackal Pup
quotes.flavor: The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.

quotes.name: Cryptolith Fragment // Aurora of Emrakul
quotes.flavor:
"I felt compelled to take the twisted stone, and I abandoned my horse's burden to accommodate its weight. Now, its continued glow illuminates my home and warms my mind."
—Garner Kroft, Moorland farmer

quotes.name: Flowering Lumberknot
quotes.flavor:
"It used to eat us trappers. Now it follows us around like some kind of hound dog."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: Sevinne, the Chronoclasm
quotes.flavor: "The best moments are worth reliving."

quotes.name: Blind Obedience
quotes.flavor: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

quotes.name: Beacon of Destruction
quotes.flavor: The Great Furnace's blessing is a spectacular sight, but the best view comes at a high cost.

quotes.name: Stonebrow, Krosan Hero
quotes.flavor: Moments after a fickle rift dropped Stonebrow in the waste of his beloved Krosa, he took up his axe in rage-blind vengeance.

quotes.name: Vanquish the Horde
quotes.flavor: Odric took no joy in violence but neither did he mourn for the twisted things he dispatched. All that mattered were the lives he had saved.

quotes.name: Merciless Executioner
quotes.flavor: He enjoys his work, for he sees only the worst Abzan criminals: those who betray their own kin.

quotes.name: River Boa
quotes.flavor:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Invasion of Lorwyn // Winnowing Forces
quotes.flavor: The Phyrexian appearance was so offensive that perfects and eyeblights worked together in unprecedented kinship to destroy them.

quotes.name: Stalker Hag
quotes.flavor: Her hunt is silent until a bone snaps or flesh tears. Her victims never know to scream.

quotes.name: Unforgiving Aim
quotes.flavor: "I tend to my field of view like a garden. Occasionally, it needs weeding."

quotes.name: Hraesvelgr of the First Brood
quotes.flavor: "Never shall our grief be assuaged nor our loss forgotten."

quotes.name: Fire-Belly Changeling
quotes.flavor:
"My ears say it hisses. My fingers say it burns."
—Auntie Wort

quotes.name: Lava Spike
quotes.flavor: "If the stabbing doesn't get ya, the melting sure will."

quotes.name: Skyhunter Skirmisher
quotes.flavor:
"Like dawn's first light, blind the unprepared and banish the shadows."
—Skyhunter creed

quotes.name: Daysquad Marshal
quotes.flavor: "The night emboldens many monsters, but the mightiest will attack in broad daylight."

quotes.name: Expressive Iteration
quotes.flavor: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

quotes.name: Stormkeld Vanguard // Bear Down
quotes.flavor: He rides like thunder and strikes like lightning.

quotes.name: Goblin Wizardry
quotes.flavor: "Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.

quotes.name: Penumbra Spider
quotes.flavor: When it snared a passing cockatrice, its own soul darkly doubled.

quotes.name: Baithook Angler // Hook-Haunt Drifter
quotes.flavor: Geor was determined to stay out until he got a bite from something big.

quotes.name: Bog Imp
quotes.flavor: On guard for larger dangers, we underestimated the power and speed of the Imp's muck-crusted claws.

quotes.name: Balduvian Horde
quotes.flavor:
"Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

quotes.name: Jacob Frye
quotes.flavor: "Toss me my brass knuckles and point me to a good brawl."

quotes.name: Keening Stone
quotes.flavor: As it spins, dead voices shriek in an ever-increasing cacophony, rending the mind asunder.

quotes.name: Dingus Egg
quotes.flavor: Legend has it that the world was hatched from a dingus egg.

quotes.name: Unstable Experiment
quotes.flavor:
"The solution is turning green! But . . . why? What does it mean?"
—Norman Osborn

quotes.name: Circuits Act
quotes.flavor: Another day, another item Pietra has to add to the "do not juggle" database.

quotes.name: Stromgald Cabal
quotes.flavor: When the alliance between Balduvia and Kjeldor deprived Stromgald of easy victories, its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.

quotes.name: Dragon's Prey
quotes.flavor:
"To escape Teval's justice, one must have a better plan than 'run away.'"
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

quotes.name: Flood the Engine
quotes.flavor: There had been a time when the Endriders would've killed for water.

quotes.name: Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper
quotes.flavor: The orcs believe Sek'Kuar still lives in the Karplusan Mountains, gathering his dead army, intent on revenge.

quotes.name: Might of Oaks
quotes.flavor: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Primevals' Glorious Rebirth
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, five dragons conquered death to rule the living.

quotes.name: Invade the City
quotes.flavor: Death greeted the world with a roar of desert air.

quotes.name: Arrester's Admonition
quotes.flavor: Law is the voice of reason.

quotes.name: Thraximundar
quotes.flavor: His name means "he who paints the earth red."

quotes.name: Wall of Kelp
quotes.flavor:
"Ya can eat it or ya can weave it, but ya can't fight in it."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

quotes.name: Graft Surgeon
quotes.flavor: When medical supplies are limited, her own cuttings will suffice.

quotes.name: Cackling Flames
quotes.flavor:
"I like a little entertainment with my dinner."
—Rakdos

quotes.name: Clear Shot
quotes.flavor:
"What worked to bring down angels will do the same for these horrors."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi

quotes.name: Reckless Lackey
quotes.flavor: "First to the fray, first to the pay!"

quotes.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
quotes.flavor: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

quotes.name: Joust Through
quotes.flavor: "Allow me to offer a counterpoint."

quotes.name: Elvish Ranger
quotes.flavor:
"How can any Human hope to match our skills? We are children of Fyndhorn, and its sap runs in our veins."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

quotes.name: Windfall
quotes.flavor:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Repercussion
quotes.flavor:
"Tugrunn threw blow after blow, howling with pain as his fist met solid rock. The creature merely stared quizzically at him, unsure when the fight would start."
—*The Goose Mother and Other Tales*

quotes.name: Pipsqueak, Rebel Strongarm
quotes.flavor: "You think my name is funny?"

quotes.name: Deadly Plot
quotes.flavor:
"Open grave available, only one previous tenant."
—Sign on cemetery gate

quotes.name: Mana Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"Those who seek to upset the balance must be taxed for such ambitions."
—Verithain, mesa high priest

quotes.name: Goblin Razerunners
quotes.flavor: Finding themselves in a new and unexplored world, they immediately set it on fire.

quotes.name: Gisa and Geralf
quotes.flavor:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

quotes.name: Tel-Jilad Fallen
quotes.flavor: "No longer am I shackled to antiquity. My new masters will etch a glorious future."

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

quotes.name: Chief Engineer
quotes.flavor: An eye for detail, a mind for numbers, a soul of clockwork.

quotes.name: Sprite Dragon
quotes.flavor: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

quotes.name: Greater Basilisk
quotes.flavor: Bone, stone . . . both taste the same to a hungry basilisk.

quotes.name: Talisman of Hierarchy
quotes.flavor:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.

quotes.name: Taniwha
quotes.flavor:
"Taniwha rolls in its sleep, and the land is awash with the waves."
—Poetics of Hanan

quotes.name: Southern Elephant
quotes.flavor: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

quotes.name: Tempting Witch
quotes.flavor:
"Murder clad in crimson beauty,
An end to life and love and duty."
—Barrow witch incantation

quotes.name: Krang, the All-Powerful
quotes.flavor: "I am Krang, the All-Powerful! I have never been defeated!"

quotes.name: Ruin Crab
quotes.flavor: 探検家にとっては、かけがえのない財宝。カニにとっては、頼れる我が家。

quotes.name: Wall of Blossoms
quotes.flavor:
"Everything in Nature contains all the powers of Nature."
—Ralph Waldo Emerson, "Compensation"

quotes.name: Seeker of the Way
quotes.flavor: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

quotes.name: Wei Infantry
quotes.flavor: Wei won the battle of Hefei when Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan and then foiled a Wu scheme to incite rebellion.

quotes.name: Exclude
quotes.flavor:
"Terrifying, but thankfully temporary."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Juggernaut
quotes.flavor: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

quotes.name: Sprite Dragon
quotes.flavor: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

quotes.name: Peter Parker // Amazing Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: "This batch of web fluid will just have to wait!"

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor:
"This is . . . I can't explain it. The opposite of all we know. A negative zone."
—Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards

quotes.name: Nantuko Husk
quotes.flavor:
"The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace."
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Nissa's Chosen
quotes.flavor: "Nissa will save the elves, but only the ones who have proved their worth."

quotes.name: Pia, Aether Ascetic
quotes.flavor: "Perhaps one day I will learn how to break the hold the Consulate has over Chandra and Kiran."

quotes.name: Shameless Charlatan
quotes.flavor: You see your next disguise in every stranger's smile.

quotes.name: Universal Automaton
quotes.flavor:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

quotes.name: Daggerdrome Imp
quotes.flavor: One of the many reasons why open-air markets close at dusk.

quotes.name: Prophetic Prism
quotes.flavor: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

quotes.name: Staggering Insight
quotes.flavor:
「真実から逃げ出すのは臆病者だけ。」
――哲人ペリソフィア

quotes.name: Kutzil, Malamet Exemplar
quotes.flavor: "Invaders in the West Chasm? Give me an hour and they'll be fungus food."

quotes.name: Steamcore Scholar
quotes.flavor: "Hm. That's weird."

quotes.name: Diffusion Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"The hive shimmered, and its walls seemed a living mirror."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

quotes.name: Archon of the Wild Rose
quotes.flavor: The curse of Redtooth Keep could only be broken by a mystical rose that blooms in moonlight.

quotes.name: Feed the Swarm
quotes.flavor:
"On vile wings and bloody wind, the swarm will rise."
—Skyclave inscription

quotes.name: Reclusive Taxidermist
quotes.flavor: All druids seek to preserve nature, but some go about it in rather unusual ways.

quotes.name: Skyblade of the Legion
quotes.flavor: Vampires call the gift of flight "exultation." For their enemies, it brings only sorrow.

quotes.name: Cabal Coffers
quotes.flavor: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun-and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

quotes.name: Slay
quotes.flavor: The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.

quotes.name: Shatter the Sky
quotes.flavor: When the gods go to war, mortals pay the highest price.

quotes.name: Tarrian's Journal // The Tomb of Aclazotz
quotes.flavor: Though officially deemed a heretic for his reverent writings on Aclazotz, Tarrian is viewed as a holy martyr by the most radical sects of the Church of Dusk.

quotes.name: Wipe Clean
quotes.flavor: "The light of the Ancestor will scour the taint of darkness from the land."

quotes.name: Call of the Conclave
quotes.flavor: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

quotes.name: Cathar's Companion
quotes.flavor:
"Unwavering and loyal, they represent stability in uncertain times."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Angels

quotes.name: Zombie Goliath
quotes.flavor:
"Removing the encumbrance of useless brain tissue grants several advantages: a slight increase in mobility, a response of revulsion and horror from the enemy, and, in the case of large specimens, room for passengers."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

quotes.name: Imperial Seal
quotes.flavor: "If Heaven has placed it in your hands, it means that the throne is destined to be yours."

quotes.name: Sphinx's Revelation
quotes.flavor: "Let the knowledge of absolute law inspire you to live a life of absolute order."

quotes.name: Ambush
quotes.flavor:
"Don't these goons have anything better to do?"
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

quotes.name: Illusory Angel
quotes.flavor:
"Yes, she is made of pure belief—but I hardly see why that makes her unique."
—Reith, master illusionist

quotes.name: Riftsweeper
quotes.flavor: "Beings of the rifts are not natural. No longer will these abominations tread upon the body of Gaea."

quotes.name: Smiting Helix
quotes.flavor: Malice is appropriate when vengeance is called for.

quotes.name: Loxodon Warhammer
quotes.flavor:
"A crafter must imbue her weapon with part of her soul—something the Phyrexians are incapable of doing."
—Melira, sylvok outcast

quotes.name: Sword of the Chosen
quotes.flavor: One shard of Selenia yet remained.

quotes.name: Memnarch
quotes.flavor: "An imperfection in the perfect world? We can't allow that."

quotes.name: Siege Modification
quotes.flavor: Perfect for getting through to the consuls.

quotes.name: Awe for the Guilds
quotes.flavor: When the guilds cooperate, the guildless celebrate their peaceful society. When the guilds clash, the guildless just try to keep out of the way.

note: Real flavor texts from the MTGJSON card corpus. Unfiltered view is a daily-stable random sample; search to reach the full corpus.
